title_vi: Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo
problem_vi: Quảng cáo xuất hiện quá nhiều gây phiền phức cho người dùng.
user_story: As a shopper, I want fewer ads, so that I can use the app without interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the app is open, when I navigate through the app, then the number of ads displayed is reduced.", "Given the app is open, when I perform actions, then ads do not interrupt my experience.", "Given the app is open, when I view products, then ads are less intrusive."]
scope_note: Cùng chủ đề quảng cáo với cụm 5, 10, 15 (và cụm 2, 9 chuyển BA): requirement có thể trùng, BA gộp nếu cần.

title_vi: Sửa lỗi tài khoản bị khóa khi giao dịch
problem_vi: Tài khoản bị khóa hoặc không đăng nhập được khi thực hiện giao dịch.
user_story: As a buyer, I want to access my account without it being locked, so that I can complete my purchases.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the user has a valid account, when they attempt to log in, then they should be able to access their account without errors.", "Given the user is logged in, when they attempt to make a purchase, then the transaction should proceed without the account being locked.", "Given the user has linked their bank account, when they attempt to withdraw funds, then the withdrawal should complete without errors."]

title_vi: Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo trong ứng dụng
problem_vi: Quảng cáo quá nhiều và gây khó chịu, thường xuyên tự động chuyển sang ứng dụng khác.
user_story: As a shopper, I want fewer intrusive ads, so that I can use the app without interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the app is running, when an ad is displayed, then it does not redirect the user to another app automatically.", "Given the app is running, when the user tries to close an ad, then the ad should close without redirecting to another app.", "Given the app is running, when the user interacts with the app, then the experience should not be interrupted by ads."]
scope_note: Cùng chủ đề quảng cáo với cụm 3, 10, 15 (và cụm 2, 9 chuyển BA): requirement có thể trùng, BA gộp nếu cần.

title_vi: Sửa lỗi lag và đơ ứng dụng
problem_vi: Ứng dụng lag và đơ liên tục, gây khó khăn khi sử dụng.
user_story: As a shopper, I want the app to run smoothly, so that I can browse products without interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the app is opened, when the user navigates through the app, then the app responds without lag or freezing.", "Given the app is in use, when the user attempts to load a product page, then the page loads within an acceptable time frame without crashing.", "Given the app is running, when the user interacts with any feature, then the app does not exit unexpectedly."]

title_vi: Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo
problem_vi: Quảng cáo của Shopee xuất hiện quá nhiều trên mọi nền tảng gây khó chịu cho người dùng.
user_story: As a shopper, I want fewer ads from Shopee on other platforms, so that I can enjoy my browsing experience without interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the user is browsing other apps, when they encounter an ad from Shopee, then the ad does not redirect them to the Shopee app or store page.", "Given the user is using the Shopee app, when they close an ad, then they remain in the app without being redirected elsewhere."]
scope_note: Cùng chủ đề quảng cáo với cụm 3, 5, 10 (và cụm 2, 9 chuyển BA): requirement có thể trùng, BA gộp nếu cần.

title_vi: Sửa lỗi không tải và đặt hàng
problem_vi: Người dùng không thể tải hoặc đặt hàng trên ứng dụng Shopee do lỗi.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to be able to load and place orders in the app, so that I can purchase items without issues.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the app is installed, when the user attempts to load the app, then the app should open without errors.", "Given the user is browsing items, when the user attempts to place an order, then the order should be processed successfully without errors.", "Given the user has a valid phone number, when the user tries to change their phone number, then the app should accept the change without errors."]
scope_note: Cụm mixed, tách theo loại (Q14): BUG 243/517 review.

title_vi: Sửa lỗi áp dụng mã voucher
problem_vi: Nhiều người dùng gặp lỗi khi áp dụng mã voucher không thành công.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to apply discount vouchers without errors, so that I can complete my purchases successfully.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given a valid discount voucher, when I attempt to apply it during checkout, then the voucher is successfully applied to my order.", "Given an account with valid vouchers, when I try to use them, then I do not receive an error message.", "Given a new account with vouchers, when I log in, then I can use the vouchers without issues."]
scope_note: Evidence chỉ gồm review BUG (222/294) (v2.6 bước 3).

title_vi: Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo trong game
problem_vi: Quảng cáo của Shopee xuất hiện liên tục trong các trò chơi, gây khó chịu cho người chơi.
user_story: As a gamer, I want to avoid being interrupted by ads, so that I can enjoy my gaming experience.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the user is playing a game, when an ad is displayed, then the ad does not redirect the user to the Shopee app.", "Given the user is playing a game, when an ad is displayed, then the user can easily close the ad without being redirected.", "Given the user is playing a game, when an ad is displayed, then the frequency of ads is reduced to enhance the gaming experience."]
scope_note: Cùng chủ đề quảng cáo với cụm 3, 5, 15 (và cụm 2, 9 chuyển BA): requirement có thể trùng, BA gộp nếu cần.

title_vi: Bổ sung tính năng hiển thị số điện thoại của shipper
problem_vi: Người dùng mong muốn có tính năng hiển thị số điện thoại của shipper để dễ liên lạc.
user_story: As a buyer, I want to see the shipper's phone number, so that I can contact them directly about my delivery.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given a delivery order, when I check the order details, then I can see the shipper's phone number displayed in the app.", "Given a delivery order, when the shipper is assigned, then the shipper's phone number is available for the user to contact.", "Given a delivery order, when the delivery is delayed, then I can call the shipper to inquire about the status."]
scope_note: Cụm lọc theo nội dung chức năng app (v2.6 bước 2): 348/1232 review app_actionable làm evidence; 884 review ngoài phạm vi app không dùng. Tập đã lọc là mixed, tách theo loại (Q14): FEATURE 190 review.

title_vi: Sửa lỗi xác minh số điện thoại
problem_vi: Người dùng không thể đăng nhập hoặc đặt hàng do lỗi xác minh số điện thoại.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to verify my phone number successfully, so that I can place orders without issues.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the user enters a valid phone number, when they attempt to verify it, then the verification process completes successfully.", "Given the user has an existing account with a registered phone number, when they try to log in, then they are granted access without errors.", "Given the user tries to place an order, when they have a verified phone number, then the order is processed without requiring additional verification."]
scope_note: Evidence chỉ gồm review BUG (187/238) (v2.6 bước 3).

title_vi: Bổ sung tính năng xem hàng trước khi thanh toán
problem_vi: Người dùng mong muốn có tính năng cho phép xem hàng trước khi thanh toán.
user_story: As a buyer, I want to see the product before payment, so that I can ensure its quality.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given a product in the cart, when the user selects to view the product, then the product details are displayed clearly before payment.", "Given a product listing, when the user clicks on the 'view product' option, then the user can see images and descriptions of the product.", "Given a product that is about to be purchased, when the user chooses to view it, then the user can confirm the product matches their expectations."]
scope_note: Cụm lọc theo nội dung chức năng app (v2.6 bước 2): 163/447 review app_actionable làm evidence; 284 review ngoài phạm vi app không dùng.

title_vi: Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo
problem_vi: Người dùng thường xuyên bị chuyển hướng đến Shopee khi đang sử dụng ứng dụng khác.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to avoid being redirected to Shopee while using other apps, so that I can continue my activities without interruption.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the user is using another app, when they interact with an ad, then they should not be redirected to the Shopee app.", "Given the user is playing a game, when an ad appears, then the ad should not cause the Shopee app to open.", "Given the user is scrolling through social media, when they accidentally touch an ad, then they should remain in the social media app without interruption."]
scope_note: Cụm mixed, tách theo loại (Q14): UX 159/517 review.

title_vi: Sửa lỗi cập nhật trạng thái giao hàng
problem_vi: Hệ thống báo đã giao hàng nhưng khách hàng chưa nhận được hàng.
user_story: As a buyer, I want accurate delivery status updates, so that I know when to expect my orders.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given an order is placed, when the delivery is not completed, then the system does not show the order as delivered.", "Given an order is marked as delivered, when the customer has not received the order, then the system allows the customer to report the issue.", "Given a delivery issue is reported, when the customer contacts support, then the support team responds within a reasonable timeframe."]
scope_note: Cụm lọc theo nội dung chức năng app (v2.6 bước 2): 348/1232 review app_actionable làm evidence; 884 review ngoài phạm vi app không dùng. Tập đã lọc là mixed, tách theo loại (Q14): BUG 153 review.

title_vi: Sửa lỗi địa chỉ giao hàng
problem_vi: Địa chỉ giao hàng bị sai mặc dù đã nhập đúng.
user_story: As a buyer, I want to enter my delivery address correctly, so that my orders are delivered to the right location.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the user enters a delivery address, when the user places an order, then the order is delivered to the entered address.", "Given the user updates their delivery address, when the user places an order, then the order reflects the updated address.", "Given the user selects a delivery address from a list, when the user places an order, then the order is delivered to the selected address."]

title_vi: Bổ sung tùy chọn giao hàng tận nơi
problem_vi: Người dùng không thể đặt hàng vì không có tùy chọn giao hàng tận nơi.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to have the option for home delivery, so that I can receive my orders conveniently.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the shopping cart contains items, when the user selects the home delivery option, then the order can be placed successfully.", "Given the user is on the checkout page, when the user chooses a delivery method, then the home delivery option is available if applicable.", "Given the user has items in the cart, when the user attempts to place an order, then the system allows the order to be completed with home delivery."]
scope_note: Cụm mixed, tách theo loại (Q14): FEATURE 115/517 review.

title_vi: Cải thiện trải nghiệm thông báo khi chơi game
problem_vi: Khi đang chơi game, thông báo làm gián đoạn trải nghiệm.
user_story: As a gamer, I want to avoid interruptions from notifications while playing games, so that I can enjoy my gaming experience without disruptions.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given the user is playing a game, when a notification is received, then the notification does not interrupt the game.", "Given the user is playing a game, when a notification is received, then the game continues to run without closing or lagging.", "Given the user is playing a game, when a notification appears, then the notification is displayed in a non-intrusive manner."]
scope_note: Evidence chỉ gồm review UX (98/163) (v2.6 bước 3).
